categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies src/torcontrol.cpp, which manages the Tor control port integration covered by P2P.
categories.rationale: Fixes an authentication failure when `-torpassword` contains backslashes by using hex-encoding per the Tor control specification. While it resolves an issue where passwords containing backslashes were mangled or rejected by Tor's parser, it affects a specific configuration edge case and is reasonably deferrable.
